text:
sanji: Seeing weird dashboard rows: customer A's metrics briefly show up in customer B's console when switching tabs. Repro: open org B, click runs, then quick filter 'edge' — metrics from org A appear for ~2s.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout svc-console v2026.03 completed at 2765439000

maria: Thanks. Can you attach logs? My hunch is session tag mismatch in router middleware.

ally: We started shipping session tags in X-Session-Tags header as CSV last week; maybe parsing/merge bug.

tim: Noted. We also added region affinity fallback that strips headers and re-injects. Could be header dedupe.

sanji: I can repro locally with two tenants and different chrome profiles. Stacktrace points to console-proxy session merge using a shared array.

maria: Paste snippet?

sanji: ```js
// console-proxy/session.js
function merge(base, patch) {
  Object.assign(base.tags || (base.tags=[]), patch.tags); // oops - mutates shared array
}
```

ally: Fix: clone arrays on merge:

```js
base.tags = [...(base.tags||[]), ...(patch.tags||[])];
```

tim: Also ensure router middleware does `req.session = {...req.session}` before re-injecting on fallback so we don't reuse object refs across requests.

maria: I'll open PR with unit/regression tests and a 10% canary on Dedicated. Test should explicitly send two sequential requests with different tags and assert no crossover.

infra-bot: incidentbot: INC-3421 created for customer-facing spikes, assigned to eng-platform oncall.

ally: Telemetry suggestion: emit `session_tag_set_size` and `session_tag_cross_read` when tags seen from previous session id are observed.

tim: Agree — include hashed request.session_id in telemetry to correlate without leaking PII.

maria: I'll own the PR. For rollback: hotfix to sanitize tags on ingress (drop header on fallback) then merge full fix.

sanji: :thumbsup: Thanks. @ally can you run the canary and watch dashboards post-merge?

ally: On it. I'll set alerts for any increase in cross-tenant reads and post results here.
